verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents a first-party PowerShell module for bulk operations across users, devices, and groups, which gives it an official command-line interface. However, it is a PowerShell cmdlet module rather than a standalone cross-platform CLI, and nothing ties it to AI/agent workflows. The GitHub support repo offers helper scripts and API examples, not a CLI. Missing for 10: standalone cross-platform official CLI, documentation of command coverage, machine-readable/agent-friendly output or AI-native workflow support, independent hands-on corroboration.
